description: Scanning the minimal-gemini fixture detects exactly three nodes (one per kind: agent, skill, markdown) with no issues. The Gemini Provider walks `.gemini/agents/` and `.gemini/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. spec 0.18.0 relocated the markdown kind to the built-in `core/markdown` Provider — `GEMINI.md` is disclaimed by gemini and picked up by core/markdown's universal fallback classify, preserving the total count.
